messages:
Diego: Alright team, pressing issue: my coworker put $20 in the office March Madness pool and I am now emotionally invested. :money_with_wings:
Harper: same. I also lost a lunch bet on the Bulls and now owe tacos. :taco:
Lena: Quick status—anyone seen injury updates? I need to know if I'm benching someone tonight before lunch.
Ethan: Just saw a thread—starter tweak: Walker listed as questionable with ankle. ETA unknown.
Diego: Ugh of course. I had him in EVERY lineup.
Harper: Pro tip: if a player's questionable, bench if you have a reliable streaming option. Unless it's a tile strategy.
Lena: Who streams well for punt assists this week? Asking for a friend (me).
Ethan: I grabbed a cheap guard off waivers who plays at least 30 mins on most nights; his ADP is low but usage popped.
scoreboard-bot: "scoreboard-bot: Live update: office pool bracket - Diego bracket advanced to Round of 32, Harper bracket eliminated, Lena on the bubble"
Diego: Wait what, how did I survive that upset? Bracket gods are fickle.
Harper: I blame the algorithm (and the snack table distraction).
Lena: Also, can we put a $5 side bet on who gets the first technical this weekend? Low stakes but high drama.
Ethan: lol yes put me in. I pick the veteran with the eyebrow.
Diego: GIF: referee blowing whistle (link)
Harper: logistics: @payroll-bot can we do Venmo collection for the pool? I can host.
payroll-bot: "payroll-bot: Diego owes $20 to #march-madness-pool. Payment link: https://venmo.com/marchpool/send - due by Friday."
Diego: Paid. :white_check_mark: Good luck to the taco winners.
Lena: Poll: who wins the East this year? React: 7E2 Celtics / 7E1 Bucks / 534 Heat / 535 Other
Ethan: 7E1 Bucks, Giannis tilt.
Harper: 534 Heat take it with defense and grit.
Diego: 7E2 Celtics if the bench keeps producing.
Lena: 535 Other, always room for chaos.
Ethan: Also FYI, I changed my lineup thinking Walker might sit. If he plays, I will send snacks to anyone who reminds me gently.
Diego: reminder: snacks are legally binding in this chat.
Harper: End thread: small stakes, big feelings. If anyone wants to join the pool late (no cashouts), DM me. Also someone owes me a taco. @Lena?
Lena: Noted. I'll pay my taco debt if my player scores 20+ tonight. Deal.
Ethan: Deal. Let the low-stakes gambling and high-carb consolation begin.
